title: Pegboard Bambu Lab badge (v2): one piece, printed face-down
subtitle: Logo-outline badge, 3 colours inlaid flush · 2 hooks 8 holes apart + 2 pins (shared pegs, 45° hook legs) · your Menards 3/16" board · X out from the board, Z up · mm
scale_note: Real size. 250 mm is as wide as the A1 bed allows. Pegs: the shared 5.7 mm sloped hook (with its behind-board leg at 45°) and 6.1 mm pins.
notes_title: What changed, and what to check
notes: v2, a rethink after the v1 print: one piece, no supports. The badge is cut to the logo's outline (like the MakerWorld one) with the colours inlaid flush: it prints face-down, so the front is the smooth first layers on the plate and all the colour changes are in the first 0.8 mm. The pegs stand straight up off the back while printing; the hooks' legs behind the board rise at 45° so they don't need support (they reach 14.5 mm behind the board's front face, less than your steel hooks). Toggle the board off to see the hooks. Check: (1) the shape and the one-line layout; (2) the colours (dark, white, green); (3) where on the board it goes: 2 hooks 8 holes apart, pins in the holes below.
